title: 'Keralam Exit Polls Are 200% Right': Congress Leader Shama Mohamed Expresses Confidence Over UDF Comeback In State - VIDEO
description: Congress leader Shama Mohamed said Kerala exit polls are “200% right” despite many predictions failing in past elections. She expressed confidence in the Congress-led UDF returning to power and said the DMK-Congress alliance would win Tamil Nadu. She also criticised the electoral process in West Bengal, alleging voter disenfranchisement.

title: Election Commission to retain 700 CAPF companies in West Bengal
description: The Election Commission of India will retain 700 Central Armed Police Forces in West Bengal for security after assembly polls amid TMC criticism.

title: BJP alleges violence and EVM tampering in West Bengal poll phase
description: Allegations of violence and EVM tampering surfaced during the second phase of the West Bengal Assembly elections. BJP leaders accused Trinamool Congress workers of attacking polling agents, while security forces maintained strict vigil amid rising political tensions across the state

title: Exit Polls failures: Nine times predictions missed the mark
description: Assembly Election Exit polls Failure History: Exit polls for West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, and Assam are awaited. However, past elections in Haryana, Lok Sabha 2024, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, and Lok Sabha 2014 and 2004 show these forecasts can be inaccurate. Voter sentiment is complex. The final results on counting day are the only ones that truly matter.

title: The Bengal laboratory
description: The deployment of Central forces in West Bengal ahead of the 2026 Assembly election is more than a security measure; it is a methodical militarisation of civic life that began at the margins, and is now moving towards the centre.
